changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Shortcut') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Shortcut]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [varchar](250) NULL, [Icon] [varchar](50) NULL, [IconUrl] [varchar](250) NULL, [Url] [varchar](250) NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [IconColor] [varchar](100) NULL, [TitleColor] [varchar](100) NULL, [BackgroundColor] [varchar](100) NULL, [DisplayOrder] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Shortcut_DisplayOrder] DEFAULT (100) NOT NULL, [LinkTarget] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Shortcut_LinkTarget] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Shortcut] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
